decision_notes: Self-governing state in free association with New Zealand, not a New Zealand province. Constitution reprinted 13 June 2022, articles 13, 39, 70 and 71 establish responsible parliamentary government, general legislation, appropriations and audit scrutiny. Classified national; audit grouping under New Zealand is only a research/search association.

The official Parliament live page footer designates this YouTube channel. Two full sitting recordings from 29 and 30 September 2020 decoded at 854x480 with advancing time and frames. Historical archive only: the current official live page has no player, the sampled Facebook replay is unavailable, and no current sitting broadcast was validated.
